verdict.rationale: The official Wally CLI runs a local model offline, and a single command points a tool at a model and starts it. That is first-party command-line launching of local models. Nothing documents a persistent local server process, a stop or shutdown command, or a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint; the only documented endpoint is Wally Cloud. Missing for 10: an explicit command to start a local model server, a documented stop/shutdown command, a documented local server endpoint, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start and stop the local model server from the command line

citations.quote: When a small model on your own machine is enough, the same CLI runs it, offline and without an account.
One command points a tool at a model and starts it.
